1957, April 11
The following is a faithful transcription of a typed original by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey O.F.M. Cap. (probably to Mr. Edward and Mrs. Winifred Brand)
ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY CAPUCHIN FATHERS 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit 7, Michigan April 11th 1957 Blessed be God in all His desighns.
God bless you Mrs. Winifred - E'd - Brand,
God bless you and yours these unsettled - tho, by the mercy of God and for men of faith, most promising days. Many thanks for your kind letter and charitable prayers.
I took that little conference in the rain as a decided privilege and am confident that in God's own good time it will prove to have been a factor in the cureing and the saving the whole Man, your poorly dear Husband, Edward Brand.
For my part, I am not exactly surprised at so little if any apparent results from his little visit hither and simple conference; This especialy since Mr. Brand has already been to so many sources of instruction and of inspiring edification, Rome, Lourdes, the Vatican, the Pope, etc, with similar results - seemingly little or noth - seemingly all in vain. .... "O' The depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensable are His judgements and how unsearchable His ways !" ... Yes. the Gospel narations are full of miraculous examples, of which the history of the Church - inas- much as it's the history of the institution of Jesus Christ - is a perfuet continuation of the same Gospel Naratives, - full of cures and of miracles, itself, as St. Augustin reminded the people
(Unfinished draft)
